veld-sp-voetbaltennis.uitleg: Two against two over a 1 m net. The ball may bounce once on your side and your team may touch it at most three times (foot, thigh or head) before it has to go back over the net. If you can't, or the ball goes out, the point goes to the other side.
veld-sp-voetbaltennis.organisatie: 8 × 14 m court with a net or tape at 1 m height in the middle (between two poles). Take turns to serve from the back line; score like tennis or play to 11.
benodigdheden: Foot volley net or tape with 2 poles
coachpunten: Soft first touch: set the ball up for your teammate
Play the ball over the net into the space where nobody is
After your touch, get back to your own half of the court

moeilijker: Each player only touches the ball once

veld-sp-voetbaltennis.meerSpelers: With more players: 3v3, or winners stay on with pairs waiting.

veld-sp-voetvolley.uitleg: One against one over a low tape. You may let the ball bounce once and touch it twice: once to control or keep it up, once to play it back. Returning it first time with a volley or header makes it extra hard for your opponent.
veld-sp-voetvolley.organisatie: 4 × 9 m court with a tape at 0.5 m height in the middle between two poles. Several courts side by side; move on after each game to 5 points.
benodigdheden: Tape or low net with 2 poles
coachpunten: Watch the ball until it touches your foot: ankle locked
Strike the ball with your laces or the inside of the foot, not your toes
Aim for the empty corner of the court

moeilijker: The ball may not bounce: volleys only
A point won with a header counts double

veld-sp-voetvolley.meerSpelers: With more players: 2v2 over the same tape, or winners stay on.

veld-sp-latje-trap.uitleg: Everyone takes turns to shoot at the big goal from 16 m. Hit the crossbar for a point; hit the post for half a point. A goal doesn't count. Who has the most points after five rounds?
veld-sp-latje-trap.organisatie: Full-size goal with no keeper. Players side by side at 16 m, each with their own ball. Fetch your own ball when it bounces back.
benodigdheden: disc cones for the shooting line
coachpunten: Strike the ball just below the middle with your laces
Standing foot next to the ball, lean back slightly
Not hard but accurate: the right height matters more than power

makkelijker: You may set the ball still first or flick it up
The post also counts as a full point
moeilijker: Only first time from a pass
Miss and you take a step back next round

veld-sp-pannavoetbal.uitleg: One against one in a small cage or marked-out area with two mini goals. A goal is a point, but if you play the ball through your opponent's legs (a panna, or nutmeg) and collect it again, you win the round straight away.
veld-sp-pannavoetbal.organisatie: Panna cage or a 9 × 6 m area (marked with benches or cones) with a mini goal at each short end. 1-minute rounds; the others wait outside and then play the winner.
coachpunten: Tempt your opponent: show them the ball and they'll step in
Go for the panna when they open their legs; then get round them quickly
Defender: don't stand with your feet wide, stay compact on your toes

makkelijker: A panna counts as a goal, you don't have to collect the ball

veld-sp-voetgolf.uitleg: A golf course on the pitch: from the tee, play the ball through the gate and into the mini goal (the 'hole') in as few kicks as possible. Take turns to kick; whoever is furthest from the hole goes first. After a round of three holes, the player with the fewest kicks wins.
veld-sp-voetgolf.organisatie: For each hole: a tee, a 4 m wide gate at about 15 m and a mini goal at 30–35 m. Set out three holes across the pitch. Players in twos or threes, each with a ball.
benodigdheden: Mini goals or cones as holes
coachpunten: Long ball: laces, ankle locked, strike through the ball
Short ball: inside of the foot, calm and accurate
Think ahead: where do you want your ball to stop?

moeilijker: The ball must go through the gate in one kick
Penalty stroke if the ball goes off the course

veld-cv-estafette.uitleg: Two teams against each other. The first player dribbles a slalom through the cones and passes to their teammate by the mini goal, who scores first time. Then they swap places. Which team scores five times first?
veld-cv-estafette.organisatie: For each team a 15 m lane with three cones and a mini goal at the end. The second player stands 3 m diagonally in front of the goal. After the shot, the shooter runs back to the start with the ball and the dribbler takes their place by the goal.
coachpunten: Slalom: quick but with the ball close to your foot
Pass at the right moment: not too early, not too late
Shoot first time, place it in the corner

makkelijker: The shooter may control the ball first

veld-pt-pionnen-omschieten.uitleg: Two teams face each other, each on their own line, with a row of cones in the middle. Try to knock the cones over with a pass along the ground. Balls that roll through can be used by the other team. Which team has knocked over the most cones after 2 minutes?
veld-pt-pionnen-omschieten.organisatie: Two lines 12 m apart, with 5 cones 3 m apart in the middle. Teams of 2–6 players, everyone with a ball. Don't step over your own line.
coachpunten: Standing foot next to the ball, pointing at your target
Inside of the foot for accuracy, laces for a hard pass
Grab the next ball quickly and aim again

makkelijker: Bigger targets (tall cones or balls on a cone)
moeilijker: First time: play the other team's ball straight back

veld-sp-piratenspel.uitleg: All the children dribble with a ball in the area. One or two pirates (without a ball) try to win a ball and kick it out of the area. If you lose your ball, you become a pirate too. Meanwhile the coach calls moves: "chop!", "sole!" or "step-over!". And when the coach calls a colour, the pirates in that bib may not tackle for a moment. Who keeps their treasure (the ball) the longest?
veld-sp-piratenspel.organisatie: 14 × 14 m area. Everyone has a ball except 1 pirate per 6 children (in a bib). Play rounds until 1 or 2 children with a ball are left. For U7–U9.
coachpunten: Small touches, ball close to your foot
Look up: where is the pirate?
Turn away and put your body between the pirate and your ball

makkelijker: The pirate may only touch the ball (not kick it away)
moeilijker: If you lose your ball, you can win one back from another pirate
Dribble with your weaker foot only

veld-sp-ludo.uitleg: A board game on the pitch. Around a square lie 16 disc cones: that is the board. Each player starts at the corner in their own colour. Take turns to roll the dice (or draw a card with a number). You earn that number with a task: on 1 or 2, keep the ball up (5 times); on 3 or 4, the slalom through the poles in the middle; on 5 or 6, a pass through the gate and fetch the ball back. If you complete the task, you move that many steps (disc cones) forward; if not, you stay where you are. Land on someone else’s disc cone and they have to go back to their own corner. The first to get all the way round wins.
veld-sp-ludo.organisatie: 12 × 12 m square with a disc cone every 3 m (16 disc cones, the four corners each in their own colour). In the middle a slalom of four poles; next to the board a gate of two disc cones 6 m away. The coach stands at the side with the dice. Everyone has a ball.
benodigdheden: 16 disc cones (4 in their own colour)
veld-sp-ludo.meerSpelers: With more players: play in pairs per colour (taking turns at the task), or set out a second board.
coachpunten: Keepy-ups: stay calm, keep the ball low and use your laces
Slalom: small touches, the ball close to your foot, with the inside and outside
Pass through the gate: standing foot next to the ball and use the inside of your foot

makkelijker: Keepy-ups with a bounce in between
One step forward even when a task fails
moeilijker: Slalom against the clock: within 10 seconds

veld-sp-uit-het-vak.uitleg: Everyone dribbles around the area with their own ball. The coach calls a colour (the colour of your bib) or a number. Only the players with that colour or number dribble out of the area as fast as they can to one of the cones outside it. Everyone else keeps dribbling and has to watch out for the players sprinting out. The first to reach a cone with the ball under control gets a point; then you dribble back into the area.
veld-sp-uit-het-vak.organisatie: 14 × 14 m area with a cone 2 m outside each side. Everyone has a ball; two or three bib colours and every player has a number. Play 2-minute blocks with short rests.
coachpunten: While dribbling: head up, so you can see the space and the others
When your colour is called: a small touch to the side first, then speed up with bigger touches
Pick the cone with a clear path to it, not always the nearest one

makkelijker: Bigger area, fewer players at a time
moeilijker: The coach calls a sum (2 + 3 = number 5)
Dribble with your weaker foot only
A task at the cone: round the cone and back into the area

veld-af-kleine-doeltjes.uitleg: Two teams, each with their own mini goal. On the signal, the front player of each queue dribbles to the shooting line and shoots at their goal. A goal = a point. Then back to the end of the queue. Which team has the most points after 3 minutes?
veld-af-kleine-doeltjes.organisatie: Two mini goals (3 m wide) 8 m apart. Shooting line of disc cones 8 m in front of the goals, the queues with balls at 18 m. Suitable for the youngest players.
coachpunten: Look up before you shoot: where is the goal?
Placement beats power: inside of the foot
Rejoin the queue quickly so your team gets its next go sooner

makkelijker: Bigger goals or two cones as a goal
moeilijker: With a keeper in each goal (then it's real finishing)
A cone to dribble round before the shooting line

veld-sp-rondje-om-het-doel.uitleg: Everyone stands in a line in front of the goal, with one player in goal as keeper. The front player dribbles to the shooting line and shoots. Then they run into the goal and become the new keeper; the old keeper joins the back of the line. If you concede a goal as keeper, you lose a life. Who has the most lives left out of three?
veld-sp-rondje-om-het-doel.organisatie: On half a pitch with a full-size goal (or a youth goal). Shooting line at 14 m. Everyone starts with three lives; once you are out of lives you can still shoot. Rounds of 5 minutes.
coachpunten: Shoot low into the corner: that is hardest for a keeper
Sprint straight after your shot: the next ball is waiting in goal
Keeper: get set on the balls of your feet, hands in front of you

makkelijker: Only lose a life for a goal, not for a save that spills
moeilijker: Shoot first time only, after a pass from the coach

veld-sp-voetbalbowlen.uitleg: Six tall cones stand in a triangle, like pins at bowling. Roll the ball with a firm pass along the ground and try to knock over as many cones as you can. Every cone that falls is a point. Then stand them up again for the next player.
veld-sp-voetbalbowlen.organisatie: Triangle of 6 tall cones (3-2-1), 30 cm apart. Passing line at 6 m (U7) to 8 m (U8–U11). Two lanes side by side, two or three children per lane; each child has two goes per round.
coachpunten: Standing foot beside the ball, toes pointing at the cones
Pass with the inside of your foot, firmly along the ground
Aim at the front cone, just slightly to one side

moeilijker: Receive the ball from a partner first, then strike it first time

veld-sp-voetbalkegelen-teams.uitleg: Each team stands in its own half with four cones behind them. Try to knock over the other team’s cones with a pass along the ground, and protect your own cones by stopping their balls. You may not cross the halfway line. The team with the last cone still standing wins.
veld-sp-voetbalkegelen-teams.organisatie: 20 × 16 m pitch with a halfway line; four cones on each end line. Two teams of 3 or 4, with three or four balls in play. Fallen cones stay down until the end of the round.
coachpunten: Look up before you pass: where is a cone unprotected?
Firm along the ground makes the ball hard to stop
Defending: step behind the ball and stop it with your sole

makkelijker: Cones closer to the halfway line

veld-sp-hooghouden-levens.uitleg: In a circle of four, keep the ball up together. You may touch the ball as often as you like before passing it on, but it must not touch the ground. If you let it drop, you lose a life. Who has the most lives left after five minutes?
veld-sp-hooghouden-levens.organisatie: Circles of 4 players, about 5 m across, one ball per circle. Everyone starts with three lives. One bounce in between is allowed at first.
coachpunten: Play the ball softly and high enough for your teammate
Control it yourself first, then pass it on
Stay on the balls of your feet, ready to move

moeilijker: The whole circle counts out loud: who sets the record?

veld-sp-chaosvoetbal.naam: Chaos football with four mini goals and three balls
veld-sp-chaosvoetbal.uitleg: Two teams play at the same time with three balls. Each team defends two mini goals and can score in the other team’s two. Something is happening everywhere on the pitch, so look around: where is a ball, where is a free goal? When you score, fetch the ball quickly and play on.
veld-sp-chaosvoetbal.organisatie: 20 × 15 m pitch with two mini goals at each short end. Two teams of 4 or 5, three balls in play at once. Rounds of 3 minutes; count all the goals.
coachpunten: Look up: where is a ball nobody has?
Free goal? Dribble quickly and score
Help defend when someone comes towards your goal
